task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Locate the metal bell with plastic parts and click its top center.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。机械臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，找到带有塑料件的金属钟，并点击其顶部中心。
